title: MemoryCandidatesDismissResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "candidate_id": string, "outcome": "dismissed" }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.candidates.dismiss (§7.14): CANDIDATE_CONSUMED, REVISION_CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, NOT_AUTHORIZED. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
